{{Wireless adapter |brand=Wistron NeWeb |model=DNUB-S1 |revision=(Samsung) |upc= |ean= |asin= |price= |est_release_date= |fcc_date=04/06/2010 |manuf_country= |is_manuf=Yes |manuf= |manuf_model= |manuf_rev= |availability= |if=USB (non-standard connector) |if_bus_version=2.0 |if_connector_type= |form_factor= |vendor_id= |device_id= |subvendor_id= |subdevice_id= |id_string= |fcc_id=A3LDNUBS1 |ic_id=649E-DNUBS1 |chip1_brand=Broadcom |chip1_model=BCM43231;BROADCOM, BCM43231KFBG, TG0932 P11, 932753 01; |chip2_brand= |chip2_model= |chip3_brand= |chip3_model= |chip4_brand= |chip4_model= |addl_chips= |accessible_UART=No |flags= |ant_conn=none |802dot11_protocols=bgn |txchains=2 |rxchains=2 |sstreams=2 |oui=00:1B:B1 |lin_driver= |win_driver= }} This module is '''Samsung''' P/N AK96-01284A. It is apparently used with some of their Blu-ray players.
"48DNUB01.SGD 2009/11/02" is silkscreened on the board in the FCC photos. :"48DNUB01.0GA QPC 2009/11/17" may be marked on some production units.
The USB pinout is marked on the board by an unpopulated 4-pin header near the ribbon cable connector.
